levels.targets: Audit at Normal and Difficile, 0 defect. Earliest exit 50 to 70 s at Normal (today 57.7 s; same length, but from decisions instead of a 47.5 m detour) and 55 to 80 s at Difficile. Route length <= 38 m (today 47.5 m for 9.5 m straight line). Waiting share 25 to 40 % with hides counted as waiting (today 18 %). At least 5 pauses of 0.5 s or more, at least 4 of them mid-route, none above 6 s (a hide counts from hide to leave). At least 2 hides at Normal (ArmoireMilieu and ArmoirePorte, or ArmoireLoin plus one), at least 3 at Difficile. Lesson wardrobe binds ('sans se cacher dans l'armoire, aucun horaire'). Rush counter-routes (R2) at Normal must lose: the route with every wait removed, and the straight path at full speed. Margins at least 0.3 s early / 0.3 s late (audit default). risks: Deviation from the review: it asked to 'shorten the mezzanine detour'; I remove the mezzanine. Without the platform the salon is crossed on the floor through the existing passage north of the Bibliotheque (z 10.35..11.9), which is shorter than the detour (about 13 m of salon instead of 23 s of mezzanine).

Deviation: the kitchen is NOT a second route. notes:
Group act3a (slots 17 and 18). Read in full: level19.json, level21.json and the neighbours level17.json (slot 16) and level20.json (slot 19), plus the review, system_map.md, mechanics.md, numbers.md and the level19/21 sections and ASCII maps of Build/numbers.log. Nothing under Assets/ was edited and Unity was not run (wave 1, read-only).

PRD length (2 to 6 minutes vs measured 10 to 57 s): 2 to 6 minutes cannot be a clean run.
